question: Where the font places a text box measured from the centre, which the end-of-game screen showed standing off its column.

addresses.name: CEU3BitmapFont::DrawText
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CEU3BitmapFont::DrawText(CEU3BitmapFont* this, Hoi3CString* text, int format, int orientation, int x, int y, int maxWidth, int maxHeight, int borderX, int borderY, int* areaSize)
addresses.comment: **Slot 8 of CEU3BitmapFont: lays a text out, places it and draws it.** `ret 0x28`. Keeps a cache of forty laid-out texts keyed by a hash of the string and every argument. A line's width is the sum of its glyphs' xadvance plus kerning; a7 and the character after it add nothing. The first line is placed by a jump table on the orientation, in a space centred on the area with **y upwards**. For UPPER_LEFT: lineY = areaHeight/2 - y - borderY; x0 = x - areaWidth/2; **format 0 (left) x0 + borderX; format 2 (centre) x0 + borderX + maxWidth/2 - lineWidth/2, each half its own integer division; format 1 (right) x0 + maxWidth - lineWidth, with no border.** For UPPER_RIGHT the origin is areaWidth/2 + x + borderX and the same three follow, so left and centre have the border twice. **Every corner of every glyph quad then has 0.5 added to x and to y** - half a pixel right and, y being upwards, half a pixel up; beside the game's pictures the maintainer's screenshot shows that as one whole pixel each way. The colour escapes are resolved here too: a7 and a letter index a table in the font at +0x4A8, 32 bytes an entry - what the `colorcodes` block fills - falling back to a table at the global 0x1B211A8; a7 '!' restores the font's own colour at +0x38. The name is ours. For CENTER (orientation 4, 0xAFCC16) x is from the middle of the area and lineY = -(y + borderY); left and right both start at x + borderX, and centre at x + borderX - widest/2 + maxWidth/2 - lineWidth/2, widest being the block's widest line (the register holding it at the switch, 0xAFCA3B), so that a single line ENDS at the middle of the box instead of being centred in it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-textdraw.md, section 2.
addresses.revises: Comment only: adds the CENTER arm of the placement switch, which the write-up had as not worked through.
addresses.evidence: Read at 0xAFCA2A..0xAFCA3B (eax the widest line, edi maxWidth) and 0xAFCC16..0xAFCCC2 (the arm, ending add esi, ecx). Would be shown wrong by a centred CENTER text box of the original standing centred in its box.
